values./system/description:
Super Sledgehammers are powered variants of the regular sledgehammer. Older, pre-War designs were outfitted with kinetic storage devices to increase the impact force, while post-War ones mount a small rocket motor within the hammer’s head to accelerate the swing and deliver a heavier blow.

A Super Sledgehammer can accept one of the following mods which are installed with the Repair skill:

  • Super Sledge: Heating Coil, Stun Pack
